lead.claim: Early quadriceps strength LSI predicts 2-year outcomes after ACLR.
lead.context: _This study assessed if early isometric quadriceps strength LSI at 3 months post-quadriceps tendon autograft ACL reconstruction predicts IKDC scores at 2 years._

supporting.claim: Traditional Chinese exercises may help musculoskeletal disorders.
supporting.context: _This umbrella review examined the efficacy and certainty of evidence for Traditional Chinese Exercises for musculoskeletal disorders._

supporting.claim: Vergence/accommodative therapy with movement helps concussions.
supporting.context: _This study assessed the effectiveness of office-based vergence/accommodative therapy with movement for accommodative dysfunction in concussion-related convergence insufficiency._

supporting.claim: Psychological readiness predicts return to sport after surgery.
supporting.context: _This study assessed if psychological readiness scores predict successful return to sport after patellar stabilization surgery in adolescents._

supporting.claim: Co-designing pain education with adolescents improves content.
supporting.context: _This study explored adolescents' needs for pain neuroscience education for low back pain through co-design._
